sample_unit: genetic counselors (pre-survey respondents; 11 completed post-surveys; 14 interviewed)
unlisted_practices: Measuring clinician burnout (Stanford Professional Fulfilment Index) before and after ambient AI scribe adoption
Qualitative interviews with clinicians on ambient scribe implementation, benefits and challenges

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the adoption and impact of an ambient AI documentation tool on burnout and clinical workflow among genetic counselors in real clinical practice, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice variant.
